context: Bee swarm plot of 400 synthetic incomes on a log scale, colored by 4 education levels, with 5 percentile reference lines, top-5 earner callout annotations, and a marginal box plot below
first_impression: Clean and readable at a glance — the 4-color swarm communicates the education-income gradient without overloading the viewer.
what_works: The 4-color Tol palette is perceptually distinct and colorblind-safe, making education categories trackable across 400 dots without a legend hunt; the marginal box plot reinforces summary stats below the swarm without cluttering the main display.
what_doesnt: The 5 top-earner leader lines all converge in a narrow strip of the right tail, creating overlapping labels and visual congestion at exactly the spot where the viewer's eye is drawn; the box plot axis labels (whisker, Q1, Med, Q3 values) are tightly packed due to log-scale compression and partially collide near the IQR box.
